blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Beneath the dense canopy of Bulusan Volcano Natural Park (BVNP) in Sorsogon, a varied community of birds continues to thrive, from colorful forest dwellers to species found only in the Philippines. A three-day avian assessment across the park’s different elevation zones documented resident, endemic and ecologically sensitive species, according to the Department of Environment and Natural Resources (DENR) Bicol. Among the birds recorded were the Philippine Trogon (Harpactes ardens), Scale-feathered Malkoha (Dasylophus cumingi), Luzon Bleeding-heart (Gallicolumba luzonica), Indigo-banded Kingfisher (Ceyx cyanopectus), Luzon Hornbill (Penelopides manillae) and Luzon Boobook (Ninox philippensis).
